paragraphs.text: Ikra Shidiqi was a naga from Tarkir 's past.

Shidiqi served as an advisor to the khan Tasigur for many years. However, after Tasigur offended the rakshasa Khudal , the naga quickly abandoned her master. She then joined Silumgar 's forces as they overthrew Tasigur and took control of the Sultai Brood . Shidiqi took great pleasure in betraying Tasigur, and her cunning nature allowed her to be promoted to Silumgar's first dragonspeaker.
